assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package may support content review as a conceptual AI-agent submission, but it cannot support statutory controls, parcel decisions, engineering feasibility, or approval conclusions.

assumptions.statement: The repository has not supplied official site and key-area polygons; the current boundary and three key areas are provisional rough geometry.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, alignments, station extents, land-use partitions, figures, PDFs, and HTML must be recalculated as one package when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: The three service zones, twelve scenario nodes, three pilgrimage landmarks, cross-links, and phasing polygons are agent-generated design proposals rather than surveyed or approved locations.
assumptions.impact: They communicate functional relationships and handoff logic only; exact positions require ownership, access, heritage, traffic, fire, accessibility, ecology, and municipal review.

assumptions.statement: The six building footprints are conceptual carriers for adaptive reuse or reversible infill and are not verified existing buildings or approved new construction.
assumptions.impact: No demolition, retention, floor area, height, structural capacity, cost, or construction decision may be inferred from them.

assumptions.statement: First-user completion, repeat use, operator handoff, service cost, and procurement outcomes have no real pilot baseline.
assumptions.impact: These metrics remain unknown; no activity count, simulated order, survey intention, media exposure, or demonstration may be reported as adoption or market evidence.

assumptions.statement: The First-Order Station and innovation procurement clinic are design mechanisms, not a government procurement, funding, contract, or implementation commitment.
assumptions.impact: Every future opportunity must state its owner, budget status, procurement route, approval state, contract responsibility, and exit conditions before public communication.

assumptions.statement: The wider contextual map uses a curated and simplified OpenStreetMap snapshot for orientation to roads, rail, waterways, stations, campuses and heritage references.
assumptions.impact: It must not be used for statutory boundaries, engineering dimensions, parcel decisions, protection buffers, accessibility conclusions or exact site positioning; all such decisions require official survey and planning data.

assumptions.statement: The CNY 0.98-1.84 million range is an agent-generated design-control assumption for one 90-day AI Origin pilot, not a supplier quote, fiscal budget, approved investment or whole-belt capital estimate.
assumptions.impact: It may support option comparison only. Decision requires official scope, site survey, quantities, procurement route, at least two quotations per item, a named accountable entity and approval.

assumptions.statement: The First-Use Commons hero image is an AI-generated concept visualization created without a third-party reference image.
assumptions.impact: It is not a photograph, measured existing condition, approved design, construction promise or evidence of user participation.

assumptions.statement: The First-Mile Passport is an empty synthetic record template with a demo identifier, null user and organization fields, no order or result, and G0-G4 gates set to PENDING.
assumptions.impact: It demonstrates the minimum evidence structure for a future pilot only. It must not be interpreted as a real participant, service event, procurement action, completed gate, verified outcome or adoption claim.

assumptions.statement: The six pilot work packages, quantities and unit-rate ranges are agent-generated concept assumptions that reconcile to the CNY 0.98-1.84 million control envelope.
assumptions.impact: They support review and option comparison only. Site verification, confirmed scope, procurement route and supplier quotations must replace the concept quantities and rates before any budget or purchasing decision.

assumptions.statement: The three flagship-scene triptych is an AI-generated concept image created from an original text prompt without third-party reference imagery.
assumptions.impact: It communicates human scale, accessibility, ordinary public life and staffed service only. It is not an existing-condition record, measured design, approved proposal, user-research result, partnership, order or construction promise.

assumptions.statement: The V2 gallery cover is an AI-generated concept image made with the submission's own First-Use Commons, brand-system and spatial-atlas assets as visual references; all service nodes are placed on accessible promenades outside a continuous preserved-rail buffer.
assumptions.impact: It communicates the three-node adoption story and a non-obstructing heritage relationship only. It is not a site photograph, measured clearance study, existing-condition record, official rendering, approved design, partnership, implementation result or construction promise.

assumptions.statement: The 0-30, 31-60, 61-75 and 76-90 day periods in the offline interactive are an agent-authored staging overlay for reviewing G0-G4 evidence release.
assumptions.impact: The timeline is not a report of current progress or completed gates. Owners, durations, acceptance evidence and stop decisions must be confirmed for a real pilot.

assumptions.statement: The two 59.7-second language editions are agent-authored communication sequences using the same proposal picture, with separate offline Mandarin and English synthesis, matching monolingual captions and locally bundled sound marks.
assumptions.impact: Its scenes, service order and 90-day sequence are narrative devices rather than records of official approval, completed infrastructure, existing procurement, confirmed partnership, live progress or real pilot results.
